title: Complete constitutive derivative audit
question: Do all first and second constitutive derivatives consumed by recovery and the characteristic symbol agree with independent invariant-preserving finite differences of the canonical master function?
prediction: Across 128 seeded three-dimensional states, all first derivatives agree within 1e-7 relative error, all density Hessian entries within 2e-5 relative error, and the generalized-pressure and scalar-source identities close within 1e-12 absolute error.
falsifier: Any nonfinite comparison occurs or any registered derivative or algebraic identity exceeds its tolerance.
controls: Density variations hold carrier density, entropy, counterflow invariant, and coherence fixed.
Carrier variations hold baryon density, entropy, counterflow invariant, and coherence fixed.
Counterflow variations hold both proper densities, entropy, and coherence fixed.
The finite-difference path is evaluated through lambda_from_invariants rather than the analytic derivative fields.
seed_rationale: The physical states and directions are generated by a fixed NumPy random seed.
